document_class.name: elsarticle
document_class.quote: Authors may use the elsarticle LaTeX class to prepare their manuscript.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.quote: Introduction: state the objectives of the work and provide an adequate background.

sections.title: Related work
sections.quote: A literature survey should be given where appropriate.

sections.title: Material and methods
sections.quote: Material and methods: provide sufficient detail to allow the work to be reproduced.

sections.title: Results and discussion
sections.quote: Results should be clear and concise; discussion should explore their significance.

sections.title: Conclusions
sections.quote: Conclusions: the main conclusions of the study may be presented in a short Conclusions section.

sections.title: References
sections.quote: References: list the references cited in the text.

sections.title: Declarations
sections.quote: Declarations: funding, competing interests and data availability statements.

abstract_words.quote: The abstract should be a maximum of 250 words.

declarations_required.quote: CRediT author statement: provide author contributions using the CRediT taxonomy.
Data availability: authors must include a data availability statement.
Funding sources: name the funding bodies that supported the work.
Declaration of competing interest is required for every submission.

reference_style.quote: Use the elsarticle-num bibliographic style with numbered references.

extras.quote: Highlights are mandatory: 3 to 5 bullet points, max 85 characters each.
